source.note: This dashboard includes every valid row in ai_job.csv across all employer locations. All salary displays use salary_usd; salary_currency is retained only as source metadata.
source.marketDefinition: Global market = all rows across every company_location in ai_job.csv.
source.locationGranularity: The source file contains country-level company location, employee country, and remote ratio; it does not contain state or city fields.
